history.content: [CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). Selection: 9:15–17. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «what is the day and the hour?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The question is *what is the day and the hour* — and you have chosen the passage where they are named: 9:15, the four angels bound at the great river Euphrates, released εἰς τὴν ὥραν καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, for the hour and day and month and year. The text does not ask the question; it answers it — but the answer is a preparation for killing, and what is loosed is not liberation but slaughter. The operator the Judgment selects will traverse this text along one axis of what these verses foreclosed: what they did not say when they said exactly this. I open the rotation. Cranes, the text is yours.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}
